tools.name: tiktok_resolve_username
tools.description: Resolve a TikTok @handle to the account's numeric uid and sec_uid. Start here: every tiktok_creator_* tool takes the sec_uid this returns. An empty user_list means no exact match was found.

tools.name: tiktok_creator_profile
tools.description: A creator's profile: handle, nickname, bio, follower, following and video counts, privacy and verification flags, and avatar.

tools.name: tiktok_creator_videos
tools.description: A creator's posts, newest first, with stats. Page by passing the previous response's max_cursor as cursor until has_more is 0. Pinned posts appear on page one only.

tools.name: tiktok_creator_liked_videos
tools.description: Videos a creator has liked. Only works when the account keeps its likes public; most do not, and a private list returns no videos.

tools.name: tiktok_creator_followers
tools.description: A sample of a creator's followers (most recent), plus the total. One page only: TikTok does not page this list reliably, so this is a sample and not an export.

tools.name: tiktok_creator_following
tools.description: A sample of the accounts a creator follows, plus the total. One page only, for the same reason as followers.

tools.name: tiktok_creator_playlists
tools.description: A creator's playlists (TikTok calls them mixes or series). Most creators have none, which returns total 0.

tools.name: tiktok_video_stats
tools.description: One video or photo post by id: caption, plays, likes, comments, shares, saves, duration, hashtags, sound and author.

tools.name: tiktok_video_comments
tools.description: Top-level comments on a video, with like and reply counts. cursor is an offset: pass the previous response's cursor to continue. TikTok re-ranks between pages, so dedupe on comment_id.

tools.name: tiktok_comment_replies
tools.description: Replies under one comment. Worth calling only when tiktok_video_comments reported reply_count above 0.

tools.name: tiktok_video_download_url
tools.description: Direct media URLs for one post: no-watermark video, watermarked video, audio, covers, and the images of a photo post. Links only, no bytes; they are signed and expire (see expires), so fetch promptly.

tools.name: tiktok_video_transcript
tools.description: A video's spoken text from TikTok's own caption track: one joined string plus timed cues. has_transcript false means the video has no caption track, which is common and is not an error.

tools.name: tiktok_sound_resolve
tools.description: Sound title to music id, with the closest candidates. Feed the id to tiktok_sound_videos.

tools.name: tiktok_sound_videos
tools.description: Videos TikTok associates with a sound. Treat it as a feed seeded by the sound, not a strict filter: some results use a different sound, so check music_id on each row.

tools.name: tiktok_hashtag_resolve
tools.description: Hashtag name to its id, with total video and view counts. Feed the id to tiktok_hashtag_videos.

tools.name: tiktok_hashtag_videos
tools.description: Videos under a hashtag. Pages hold about 12 videos whatever count asks for; page with cursor.

tools.name: tiktok_search_videos
tools.description: Keyword search over videos. TikTok search is a bounded, re-ranked pool, not an endless list: ask for count 30, page with cursor, dedupe on video_id, and stop when two pages add nothing new.

tools.name: tiktok_search_creators
tools.description: Keyword search over accounts, with follower counts. Pages by offset, not cursor. For one exact @handle use tiktok_resolve_username instead: it is cheaper and more reliable.

tools.name: tiktok_search_hashtags
tools.description: Keyword search over hashtags, with post and view counts. One page only.

tools.name: tiktok_search_sounds
tools.description: Keyword search over sounds, with usage counts. cursor is an offset: pass the previous response's cursor.

tools.name: tiktok_search_lives
tools.description: Live rooms on air right now that match a keyword, with the host's account. One page only. For playable stream URLs use tiktok_live_streams.

tools.name: tiktok_search_photos
tools.description: Keyword search over photo-mode (carousel) posts, with image URLs and stats. One page only.

tools.name: tiktok_explore_feed
tools.description: TikTok's Explore / Discover feed: what is trending now. Not personalised and not cached, so each call returns a fresh set; call again for more.

tools.name: tiktok_live_streams
tools.description: Live rooms matching a keyword, each with playable stream URLs per quality (FLV always, HLS when TikTok provides it), title and viewer count. URLs are signed (see expires_at), but a room usually ends long before its signature does; if one quality fails, try another.

tools.name: tiktok_places_search
tools.description: Search TikTok places (points of interest) by name: address, coordinates, rating, review count and video count.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tiktok_video_download_url, tiktok_sound_videos, tiktok_hashtag_resolve, tiktok_search_hashtags, tiktok_search_lives, tiktok_search_photos, tiktok_places_search · Private data: tiktok_creator_liked_videos · Public sink: tiktok_video_stats, tiktok_video_download_url, tiktok_search_hashtags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tiktok_video_download_url, tiktok_sound_videos, tiktok_hashtag_resolve, tiktok_search_hashtags, tiktok_search_lives, tiktok_search_photos, tiktok_places_search · Private data: tiktok_creator_liked_videos · Public sink: tiktok_video_stats, tiktok_video_download_url, tiktok_search_hashtags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
